completion.source: Insider Gaming's 100% completion task list, as reported by GTA VI Vice City Hub. Where a task's target differs from a trophy's own PSN counter, the trophy counter is the one that matters for the trophy — the 100% list is the game's own checklist, and this guide notes the two places they disagree (meditation spots: 15 here, 18 on the trophy; see the trophy's own guide).

saveStrategy: GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. The game gives you 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave: keep one at the start and one at the end of every chapter (10 saves), then rotate the remaining 5 for free-roam cleanup. Cheats switch trophies off for that session, and saving too — so play the whole run clean. PowerPyx's reassurance, worth knowing before you worry: optional missions disappearing does not matter for trophies, quest givers who go quiet (Kenton, for example) come back for every trophy-related strand, fences that disappear do not affect any trophy, and a few magazine collectibles in story buildings that become inaccessible also spawn elsewhere. If a trophy can be missed, this guide says so on the trophy itself and on the Missables page.

stages.note: Chapters 1–5 and the finale, about 60–80 hours. Twelve trophies: six chapter and finale milestones and six named missions. PowerPyx's roadmap is three steps — the story, then the 100% checklist (about 100 hours), then the stranger strands and cleanup (about 10 hours) — for roughly 200 hours to the Platinum at difficulty 4/10. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends: it is the only trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs that meditation — do it anyway. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.note: Eight stranger strands across Leonida — but read this carefully, because the obvious reading is wrong: the five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) do NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks. The strands PowerPyx confirms do count are Kirk (Skunk Ape and Mr. Mangrove), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, with more strangers yet to be discovered. Start every strand as soon as it appears. PowerPyx confirms the open-world stranger strands are still there after the story, so nothing here forces a reload — but the five named finals are their own trophies, and each has its own strand to finish.
stages.title: Strangers and side missions

stages.note: The repeatable core: shooting range golds, races, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling, pool, mini golf, stunts, challenges, meditation, hunting and the odd one-offs. Nothing here is missable except one at-risk trophy: Cal's fishing challenge (Baited My Tackle), a one-off encounter with no confirmed replay — take it the first time it is offered. The VCIA plane stunt (Catch Me If You Can) is repeatable in free roam, and the stranger strands stay available after the story, so neither forces a reload. The 9 activity types for Master of None are Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race or Drone Race, and performing a Stunt.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.note: Heists, vaults, shops, armored trucks, gang operations, laundering, spending and properties — plus the collectibles: card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicles and garage deeds. All repeatable in free roam. Work the money trophies together: vaults and trucks feed Marked Bills, which feed the $250,000 laundering total.
stages.title: Crime, money and collections

stages.note: Finish the 35-task completion list below. PowerPyx stresses it is closer to 60% true completion: you only need 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and any 70 of 80 challenges. Its targets still run higher than the matching trophies (300 stunts against 250, 70 challenges against 50, 15 card sets against 3, all 8 vaults against 5), so the cleanup keeps going after those trophies pop. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts. A Long Road pops at 100%, and the Platinum pops with it.
